'''Adar 5 (April 17)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Egwene al'Vere]] and [[Perrin Aybara]] leave the [[Tinker]]s' caravan and resume traveling with [[Elyas Machera]]. [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] arrive in [[Whitebridge]]. [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] work on a farm, but are driven off with dogs.
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Elayne Trakand]] is kidnapped by the [[Black Ajah]]. [[Birgitte Silverbow]] and [[Sea Folk]] [[Windfinder]]s rescue her.
